11 year old Adrian Ross has put in some very useful sprint times this year and elsewhere you will read of his excellent leg in the 25x1 mile relay.
But perhaps the best performance of all came from 12 year old Adrian Ross who zipped round one lap in 61.1 for a remarkable new club colts record.

Andy's spikes went missing five minutes before the start and he borrowed a pair from Adrian Ross. Andy was about twenty seconds up at the end of the first lap and had increased this to twenty eight at the finish, in what was a very fine performance.

Adrian Ross rounded off a fine season, which saw him capture the Berkshire County Boys 400m and 800m titles and the Berkshire Schools 800m, by running the remarkable time of 2.03.79 in a Boys Invitation 800m at Crystal Palace on 14 September. This mark constitutes a club record and finally removes a number of venerable 880 yards performances from the books.

Good progress was made by a number of youngsters at this distance, notably Steven Garcia, Alistair Grant and Adrian Ross. 800m John Gladwin won the UK Championships at this distance before a pelvic problem affected the heart of his season.
